mapper.select: SELECT q.id, q.token, q.title, q.vessel_name AS vesselName, q.content, q.is_active AS isActive, q.created_by AS createdBy, q.created_at AS createdAt, q.expires_at AS expiresAt, (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM tb_safety_qr_record r WHERE r.qr_id = q.id) AS recordCount FROM tb_safety_qr q ORDER BY q.created_at DESC

SELECT q.id, q.token, q.title, q.vessel_name AS vesselName, q.content, q.is_active AS isActive, q.created_by AS createdBy, q.created_at AS createdAt, q.expires_at AS expiresAt, (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM tb_safety_qr_record r WHERE r.qr_id = q.id) AS recordCount FROM tb_safety_qr q WHERE q.id = #{id}
SELECT id, token, title, vessel_name AS vesselName, content, is_active AS isActive, created_by AS createdBy, created_at AS createdAt, expires_at AS expiresAt FROM tb_safety_qr WHERE token = #{token}
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO tb_safety_qr (token, title, vessel_name, content, is_active, created_by, expires_at) VALUES (#{token}, #{title}, #{vesselName}, #{content}, 1, #{createdBy}, #{expiresAt})
mapper.update: UPDATE tb_safety_qr SET is_active = 0 WHERE id = #{id}
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO tb_safety_qr_record (qr_id, worker_name, vessel_name, work_date, gender, phone) VALUES (#{qrId}, #{workerName}, #{vesselName}, #{workDate}, #{gender}, #{phone})
mapper.select: SELECT r.id, r.qr_id AS qrId, q.title AS qrTitle, r.worker_name AS workerName, r.vessel_name AS vesselName, r.work_date AS workDate, r.gender, r.phone, r.completed_at AS completedAt FROM tb_safety_qr_record r JOIN tb_safety_qr q ON q.id = r.qr_id WHERE r.qr_id = #{qrId} ORDER BY r.completed_at DESC
SELECT COUNT(*) FROM tb_safety_qr_record WHERE qr_id = #{qrId}
